name: Phyllotaxis Bloom
desc: A sunflower seed-head of golden-angle florets that spirals out from center and slowly rotates, blooming and wilting across sections, with a perturbable divergence angle that fractures the lattice into spiral arms, in botanical, ink-engraving, iridescent-nacre and blueprint-schematic styles.

spread.doc: radial spacing constant (wider bloom at max)

angleTweak.doc: divergence-angle offset from 137.5 deg (fractures into spiral arms)

style.doc: render philosophy: shaded seed-to-petal florets / monochrome ink stipple plate / oil-slick nacreous glow / blueprint parastichy vector lattice

act.doc: multi-minute dramaturgy: grow-and-hold / cyclic bloom+wilt / count pulses with sections
